children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on Godrej Consumer Products

GCPL’s 2Q results were a miss on EBITDA/PAT. Revenue growth was strong at 19% (in line), while EBITDA/PAT grew 12%/9% yoy and missed expectations by 2%/5%. Volume growth was strong at 8% at consolidated level and 7% for India. Growth was led by home care, while personal care lagged. Indonesia and GAUM continued to exceed growth expectations. However, margins remained under pressure, with gross margin contracting by 300bps yoy (-40bps qoq) due to higher input costs. EBITDA margin decline was lower at 120bps yoy due to lower A&P spends (+2% yoy). GCPL reiterated its FY27 guidance of double-digit growth in consolidated revenue and EBITDA, which we believe is achievable. However, deteriorating macros pose a risk. We cut our FY27-29E earnings by 3-6%, mainly due to lower margin assumptions as we expect input costs to remain elevated for longer. We also cut our valuation multiple by ~9% to factor in the increasing uncertainty due to El Niño, inflation, and overhang of the pending India CEO appointment.
We expect sales/earnings CAGR of 12%/15%, which is higher than most peers. Hence, we maintain BUY while cutting our TP by 12% to Rs1,100 (from Rs1,250), based on 39x Sep-28E EPS.
